statements.subject: transaction
statements.description: When a message is delivered or forwarded to each address of an expanded list form, the return address in the envelope ("MAIL FROM:") MUST be changed to be the address of a person or other entity who administers the list.
statements.guard_semantics: message is being forwarded to expanded mailing list recipients

statements.subject: message
statements.description: In the case of list forwarding, the message header section MUST be left unchanged; in particular, the "From" field of the header section is unaffected.
statements.guard_semantics: message is being forwarded to expanded mailing list recipients

statements.subject: server
statements.description: When a message is sent to a pseudo-mailbox (exploder), copies are forwarded or redistributed to each mailbox in the expanded list, with MAIL FROM changed to the list administrator and message headers left unchanged.
statements.trigger: recipient address resolves to mailing list or alias
actions: expand alias or list to individual recipient addresses
set MAIL FROM to list administrator address
forward copy of message to each expanded recipient
